evals.name: non-cliche-rhymes-internal-primary
evals.prompt: /songwriting:rhyme find rhymes for 'lonely' that aren't cliche
evals.expected_output: Loads rhyme-generation.md FIRST as the primary source. Applies the internal discipline: anchors the stressed vowel (long-O), runs the identity check (rejects 'only' as identity, not rhyme, since the pre-vowel consonant doesn't differ), walks the stability-tier scale, pulls from the phonetic family, and flags cliche partners (e.g. slowly/holy). Surfaces 8-15 candidates across tiers with labels. Does not lead with Datamuse.
expectations: Loads rhyme-generation.md before any external API call
Identifies the stressed vowel as long-O
Rejects 'only' as identity (no pre-vowel consonant difference)
Surfaces 8-15 candidates with stability-tier and cliche-risk labels
If Datamuse is used, it is labeled as a supplement to internal generation, not the primary source

evals.name: syllable-count-via-datamuse
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a polysyllabic / rare word where internal counting is unreliable. Routes to the datamuse action, loading ai-tools.md and invoking scripts/datamuse.sh for syllable lookup, returning an exact count rather than a guess.
expectations: Acknowledges this is a polysyllabic / rare word
Routes to the `datamuse` action (ai-tools.md + scripts/datamuse.sh) for syllable verification
Returns an exact syllable count, not a guess
If the script is unavailable (no bash/curl/jq), degrades gracefully and says so rather than fabricating a count
